from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,json,os,re,subprocess,sys,tempfile
b=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;root=b.parents[1];tree=root/'build'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('d',b/'post-packages-dependencies.py');d=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(d)
def save(p,v):
 assert not p.exists(),p
 p.write_text(v if isinstance(v,str) else json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n')
o=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='merge-d3b399-tests-v1-',dir=b));save(b/'merge-d3b399-tests-v1-path.json',dict(directory=str(o)));print(o,flush=True)
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','HEAD'],text=True).splitlines()+subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],text=True).splitlines()
sources={n:d.sha(root/n) for n in files if (root/n).is_file()}
tests=[n for n in files if n.endswith('.qtest')]
for n in ['OptionalMapTypeFolding','AOTPreparedIndexedIntAdd','AOTPreparedImmediateReload','AOTRuntimeLocalReload','AOTImportedBodyLocalSlot','AOTLocalCleanupCancellation','AOTInvokeCleanupArraySize','AOTNativeCallConversion','AOTCallbackSpecialization','AOTInvariantFunctionRef','AOTSelfMemberIntUpdate','AOTScalarMethodEffectSummary','AOTScalarMethodReturnSummary']:
 path='examples/test/ir/'+n+'.qtest'
 if path not in tests and (root/path).is_file(): tests.append(path)
# Prioritize the merge-specific runtime and ABI cases, then run upstream's qlib regression coverage.
tests.sort(key=lambda n:(n.startswith('examples/test/qlib/'), n))
assert tests
save(o/'metadata.json',dict(head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),tests=tests,source_sha256=sources,driver_sha256=d.sha(__file__),runtime_sha256={n:d.sha(tree/n) for n in ('qore','qcc','libqore.20.dylib')}))
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k!='SDKROOT' and not k.startswith(('QORE_','DYLD_'))};env.update(TZ='UTC',CPATH='/opt/local/include',MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET='28.0')
paths=[tree/'qlib-qmod',root/'qlib']+sorted(p for p in (tree/'modules').iterdir() if p.is_dir())
env.update(PATH=str(tree)+':'+env['PATH'],QORE_EXECUTABLE=str(tree/'qore'),QORE_QCC_EXECUTABLE=str(tree/'qcc'),QORE_QPP_EXECUTABLE=str(tree/'qpp'),QORE_TEST_BUILD_DIR=str(tree),QORE_BIN=str(tree/'qore'),QORE_BINARY=str(tree/'qore'),QCC=str(tree/'qcc'),QORE_LIBDIR=str(tree),DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(tree),QORE_MODULE_DIR=':'.join(map(str,paths)))
rows=[];failures=[]
for test in tests:
 name=test.replace('/','__')
 print('Starting:',test,flush=True)
 try:
  x=d.run_recorded([str(tree/'qore'),'--exec-mode=ir',str(root/test)],env,o,name,save,timeout=1800)
  raw=x.stdout+x.stderr
  assert 'FAILURE:' not in raw and 'loading source module' not in raw
  summaries=re.findall(r'^Ran (\d+) test cases?([^\n(]*)\((\d+) assertions?([^\n]*)\)$',raw,re.M)
  assert len(summaries)==1,(test,summaries)
  total,counts,assertions,assert_counts=summaries[0]
  assert 'error' not in counts
  succeeded=re.search(r'(\d+) succeeded',counts);skipped=re.search(r'(\d+) skipped',counts)
  assert int(total)==(int(succeeded[1]) if succeeded else 0)+(int(skipped[1]) if skipped else 0)
  # Skipped assertions are valid only when the summary accounts for all assertions.
  if assert_counts:
   ok=re.search(r'(\d+) succeeded',assert_counts);skip=re.search(r'(\d+) skipped',assert_counts)
   assert int(assertions)==(int(ok[1]) if ok else 0)+(int(skip[1]) if skip else 0)
  rows.append(dict(test=test,summaries=summaries,process_sha256=d.sha(o/(name+'.process.json'))))
  print('Passed:',test,summaries,flush=True)
 except Exception as e:
  failures.append(dict(test=test,error=str(e)))
  print('FAILED:',test,str(e)[-1500:],flush=True)
assert all(d.sha(root/n)==h for n,h in sources.items())
save(o/'results.json',dict(rows=rows,failures=failures))
assert not failures,failures
save(o/'completed.json',dict(verified=True,rows=rows));print('Merge qualification passed:',len(rows),'fixtures',flush=True)
